name: Pembrokeshire Wales Coastal Holidays
accommodation: Seven homes at Freshwater Bay Holiday Village sleeping 4 to 6
beachAccess: About 300 metres to Freshwater East beach (Visit Pembrokeshire)
confirmedFeatures: Wi-Fi, games room, café, on-site pub/restaurant (seasonal), cots and highchairs
overview: Pembrokeshire Wales Coastal Holidays lets seven family-owned homes at Freshwater Bay Holiday Village, about 300 metres behind Freshwater East beach. They sleep four to six and the village has a café and seasonal pub.
surfTripFit: Walking distance to the beach and self-catering kitchens make it practical for a family surf week.
